endpoints.description: Create a response; stream=true switches to SSE events.
Retrieve a stored response (requires store=true at creation).
List the input items of a stored response.

request_shapes.name: responses-request
request_shapes.notes: input is a string or a typed item list (message/reasoning/function_call items); built-in tools include web_search, file_search, computer_use_preview.

response_shapes.name: response-object
response_shapes.notes: output[] is a typed item list; status is queued|in_progress|completed|failed|incomplete|cancelled.

response_shapes.name: response-events
response_shapes.notes: Semantic events, not raw deltas — each event carries a typed payload and sequence_number.

rate_limits.meaning: seconds to wait before retrying a 429

streaming.notes: Typed semantic events over SSE; no [DONE] sentinel — the stream ends with response.completed or response.failed.

deviations.behavior: Chat Completions is stateless (the caller resends the whole message list); Responses keeps conversation state server-side via previous_response_id and store=true.
Chat carries flat messages[]; Responses carries typed input/output items (message, reasoning, function_call, function_call_output, file_search_call, web_search_call, computer_call).
Chat emits raw chat.completion.chunk deltas; Responses emits semantic events (response.output_text.delta, response.output_item.done, …).
Chat tools are caller-executed functions only; Responses adds server-side built-in tools (web_search, file_search, computer_use_preview, image_generation).
